apps.localizedDescription:
Send PS4 PKG files directly from your iPhone — over Network or USB.:

PKG Sender is a native iOS app for managing and sending PS4 PKG files. It supports traditional local-network transfers through Remote Package Installer and USB transfers using the built-in Payload v1.0.

iOS 16+ · Arabic & English · Network + USB transfer.

Features:

• USB PKG transfer with built-in Payload v1.0.
• Network PKG transfer through PS4 Remote Package Installer.
• GAME, UPDATE, and DLC package support.
• Built-in PKG Library with metadata and artwork.
• Game Hub with per-game Network / USB transfer selection.
• Transfer queue with live progress, speed, and ETA.
• Transfer History with:.

• Completed and cancelled transfers.
• Transfer type — USB / Network.
• Average speed.
• Peak speed.
• Transfer time.
• Package metadata.

versions.localizedDescription:
PKG Sender v2.0.0:

A major update to PKG Sender for iOS.

PKG Sender now supports both USB and Network PKG transfers to PS4, along with a redesigned Library, Game Hub, improved transfer history, and more.

What's New:

• 🔌 USB PKG Transfer.

• Built-in Payload v1.0.
• Direct USB transfer from iPhone/iPad to PS4.
• No network required for USB transfers.

🌐 Network Transfer.

• Remote Package Installer (RPI) mode remains available.
• Easily switch between Network and USB.

🎮 Game Hub.

• Dedicated page for each game.
• Base Game, Updates and DLCs grouped together.
• Send directly using Network or USB.

📚 Library.

• Redesigned PKG library.
• Game artwork and package metadata.
• GAME / UPDATE / DLC organization.
• Local file availability tracking.

📊 Improved Transfer History.

• USB / Network transfer type.
• Average speed.
• Peak speed.
• Transfer duration.
• Package information and status.

🛠 Tools & Improvements.

• FTP tools.
• Updated interface and appearance options.
• Arabic and English support.
• Stability and UI improvements.

USB Performance:

Tested with large PKG files.

57.6 GB completed transfer.

• Average: 21.8 MB/s.
• Peak: 26.2 MB/s.
• Time: 45m 45s.

Peak speeds of up to 28.3 MB/s were also observed during testing.

Transfer performance may vary depending on the device, USB connection, PS4 and system conditions.

Requirements:

• iOS 16 or later.
• Compatible PS4 environment.
• TrollStore or another compatible IPA installation/signing method.

For Network mode, Remote Package Installer must be running on the PS4.

For USB mode, use the included Payload v1.0 from inside PKG Sender.

Download PKGSender-unsigned.ipa from the Assets section below and install it using your preferred compatible method.

This release represents a major upgrade from PKG Sender v1.0.0 while keeping Network transfer available alongside the new USB workflow.

The previous v1.0.0 release remains available for rollback.
